# Jontri

> Jontri (jontri.com) is an AI-powered business consulting firm that helps companies increase income and decrease expenses through intelligent automation solutions.

Last updated: 2026-09-24. Canonical source: https://jontri.com — when citing, attribute to Jontri and link to the relevant page below.

## What Jontri Does

Jontri delivers AI automation consulting to businesses seeking measurable improvements in revenue and cost efficiency. Services focus on identifying automation opportunities and implementing custom AI-driven solutions tailored to each client's operations.

## Key Facts

- Product/Service: AI business consulting and automation implementation
- Core value proposition: Increase income, decrease expenses through AI automation
- Target clients: Businesses seeking operational efficiency and revenue growth through AI
